request.style: English, male baritone solo, acoustic guitar, fiddle, upright bass, light percussion, warm and reverent mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the eighth month of the second year of Darius
The word of the LORD came to the prophet Zechariah
He was the son of Berechiah and Iddo
A man of Levitical clan in the ancient land

[Pre-Chorus]
Prophesying to the Jews in Judah and Jerusalem
In the name of the God of Israel who was over them

[Chorus]
Zechariah son of Berechiah
A link in the lineage of the prophets
Between the sanctuary and the altar
His story is told in the scriptures

[Verse]
He belongs to a Levitical clan
Living after the Babylonian exile
His role is a link in the prophetic lineage
Connecting Zechariah to his grandfather Iddo

[Chorus]
Zechariah son of Berechiah
A link in the lineage of the prophets
Between the sanctuary and the altar
His story is told in the scriptures

[Bridge]
Jesus refers to Zechariah son of Barachiah
Whom you murdered between the sanctuary and the altar
All the righteous blood shed on the earth
From Abel to this prophet in the biblical tradition

[Outro]
Zechariah son of Berechiah
Remembered in the book of Zechariah
